name: Addison Airport

runway.v: one runway, 7,203 ft (about 2,195 m) x 100 ft

hours.v: airport open 24 hours, 7 days; control tower 06:00-22:00 daily
hours.quote: Addison Airport (ADS) is open 24 hours per day, seven days per week.

customs.v: US Customs at 4545 Jimmy Doolittle, Suite 100; normal hours Mon-Fri 10:00-19:00; weekends, holidays and after hours by appointment (call before 16:30, for weekends by the Friday before), after-hours fee USD 325; user fee USD 100-500 by MTOW
customs.quote: Normal hours of service are 10:00am-7:00pm Monday through Friday.

handling.v: three 24-hour FBOs: Million Air, Galaxy and Atlantic Aviation
handling.quote: Three 24-hour full service fixed base operators: Million Air, Galaxy & Atlantic Aviation

noise.v: departures should follow NBAA noise procedures unless ATC directs otherwise; engine run-ups only 06:00-22:00
noise.quote: All aircraft maintenance engine run-ups shall be conducted between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m.

notes: Read Addison Airport pages (Services and Quick Facts, U.S. Customs, FAQ; no dates, footer 2026) and the Rules and Regulations adopted 14 Dec 2010. No curfew is stated; the airport says it is open 24 hours. Quick Facts says '24-hour U.S. Customs' while the Customs page gives normal hours Mon-Fri 10:00-19:00 with other times by appointment; I record the normal hours. CBP fact sheet (https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2025-11/KADS%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020251106.pdf) could not be opened. FAA Chart Supplement / d-TPP (aeronav.faa.gov), FAA NFDC airport data (nfdc.faa.gov, robots-blocked) and ADIP (adip.faa.gov) could not be opened. Metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m).
